title: ranunculus dolichanthus
intro: Ranunculus dolichanthus, commonly known as the yellow sea buttercup, is a plant species in the ranunculaceae family. It is a flowering plant known to have various health benefits, including the ability to treat inflammation, reduce fever, and act as an antiseptic agent to promote wound healing. The therapeutic actions of Ranunculus dolichanthus include its anti-inflammatory and antipyretic properties, which can help alleviate symptoms of various health conditions. The plant contains bioactive constituents such as alkaloids, flavonoids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
